subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Modern technology has created many new jobs that require ______ skills and knowledge.
solution:
The correct answer is 'specialised.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about the requirement of skills and knowledge in the jobs created by modern technology.
 
• The use of the word 'knowledge' in the sentence indicates **facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is '**specialised**'.
 
• The word 'specialised' means **having or needing deep or special knowledge of a particular subject**. 
 
 
• Example:* Unlike snakes, lizards have not **specialised** in chemical warfare*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete Sentence: *Modern technology has created many new jobs that require specialised skills and knowledge*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Hard' means **difficult to do or understand; not easy**. (जिसे करना या समझना कठिन हो, दुष्‍कर और दुर्बोध; कठिन)
 
• '**Dangerous**' means **likely to cause injury or damage**. (ख़तरनाक, भयंकर)
 
• 'Common' means **happening or found often or in many places; usual**. (सामान्‍य, आम)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य **आधुनिक तकनीक द्वारा सृजित नौकरियों में कौशल और ज्ञान की आवश्यकता के बारे में** बात कर रहा है।
 
• वाक्य में 'knowledge' शब्द का प्रयोग **अनुभव या शिक्षा के माध्यम से प्राप्त तथ्यों, सूचनाओं और कौशल** को इंगित करता है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'specialised' है।
 
• 'Specialised' शब्द का अर्थ है **किसी क्षेत्र-विशेष में विशेषज्ञता प्राप्‍त**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *Unlike snakes, lizards have not specialised in chemical warfare*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *Modern technology has created many new jobs that require specialised skills and knowledge*.
